inherited.inherited_unit:067.list:
- No file format registers an importer or exporter for PDF, PLY, RVM, U3D, JT, AMF, HTML5,
  A3DW, USD, or Draco in this build — `PdfSaveOptions`, `PlyLoadOptions`, `DracoSaveOptions`,
  and similar option classes exist as public types, but `Scene.open()`/`Scene.save()` cannot
  detect or dispatch any of these extensions, and raise a `RuntimeError` if you try.
- FBX support is experimental. `FbxImporter` has a real, working ASCII/binary tokenizer and
  parser, but no bundled test opens a real `.fbx` fixture through it — the only FBX tests
  exercise the tokenizer directly against hand-written snippets — so treat FBX import as
  lightly verified rather than production-hardened. `FbxExporter.save()`/`save_to_stream()`
  both raise `NotImplementedError` outright, so FBX is import-only at best.
- COLLADA import works, but COLLADA export is not reachable through `Scene.save()`:
  `IOService`'s exporter lookup walks its registered exporters in order and reaches
  `FbxExporter` (whose `supports_format()` is unimplemented and raises unconditionally) before
  it ever reaches `ColladaExporter`, so the lookup itself fails before a real, working
  `ColladaExporter` is ever consulted — reproduced directly against this build.
- Always import a format's load/save options class from its own format submodule (as every
  example in this README does), never from the shared top-level `aspose.threed.formats`
  package — for OBJ, STL, glTF, and COLLADA specifically, the top-level package name resolves
  to a broken duplicate with no working base class, which format detection silently rejects.
  3MF and FBX are unaffected. Import COLLADA classes by their exact file path
  (`aspose.threed.formats.collada.ColladaLoadOptions`, and so on) — that submodule has no
  package-init re-export, so the shorter package-style import used for other formats resolves
  to a module object instead of the class you want.
- `Scene.render()` and the entire `aspose.threed.render` module (`Renderer`, `RenderFactory`,
  `Viewport`, and related classes) raise `NotImplementedError` — this library does not render
  scenes to images.
- `Texture` and `TextureBase` raise `NotImplementedError` on construction, so an image-backed
  texture cannot be created; material color and factor properties (`diffuse_color`,
  `albedo`, `metallic_factor`, and similar) work independently of texture assignment.
- `Watermark.encode_watermark()`/`decode_watermark()` and every `TransformBuilder` method raise
  `NotImplementedError` — build node transforms through `Transform`'s own translation,
  rotation, and scaling properties instead of the fluent `TransformBuilder` chain.
- `Mesh.do_boolean()`, `union()`, `difference()`, and `intersect()` raise `NotImplementedError`
  — Boolean/CSG mesh operations are not implemented, even though `BooleanOperator` and
  `BooleanOperand` exist as configuration holders.
- `NurbsCurve.evaluate()`/`evaluate_at()` and `NurbsSurface.to_mesh()` raise
  `NotImplementedError` — NURBS curves and surfaces can be configured but not sampled or
  converted to a `Mesh`.
- `PointCloud.from_geometry()`/`from_geometry_with_density()` raise `NotImplementedError`, and
  `AxisSystem` raises `NotImplementedError` on every method, including construction.

inherited.inherited_unit:056.list:
- **Only `.xlsx` (OOXML) is supported for load and save.** `LoadFormat` and `SaveFormat` each
  declare a single `Xlsx` member; saving to any other format throws
  `UnsupportedFeatureException("Only XLSX save is supported.")`. There is no `.xls`, `.xlsb`,
  `.ods`, or `.csv` read/write support.
- **Legacy SpreadsheetML (the pre-OOXML Excel 2003 XML dialect) is not implemented.** The mapper
  classes for it (`WorkbookXmlMapper`, `WorksheetXmlMapper`, `StylesheetXmlMapper`,
  `SharedStringTableXmlMapper`) exist in source but their read/write methods unconditionally
  throw `UnsupportedFeatureException`.
- **Cell-level comments/notes are not modeled as a distinct object.** The only `Comment` field in
  the public API belongs to `DefinedName` — a description string on a named range, not an Excel
  cell note or threaded comment.
- **Some advanced conditional-formatting rule types are recognized on load but not preserved.**
  An unsupported rule type is dropped with a `WarningInfo` diagnostic rather than failing the
  load outright.
- **AutoFilter date-group filters using certain patterns are rejected as unsupported during
  load** rather than approximated.

example:002.value:
doc := pdf.NewDocumentFromFormat(pdf.PageFormatA4)
flow := doc.NewFlow(pdf.FlowOptions{})
flow.AddHeading(1, "Quarterly Report", pdf.TextStyle{})
flow.AddParagraph("Revenue grew in every region this quarter.", pdf.TextStyle{Size: 11})
flow.AddList([]string{"North: +12%", "South: +8%"}, false, pdf.TextStyle{Size: 11})

if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
fmt.Println("pages:", pages)

attributes.docstring: Flow is a document generator that lays content out top-to-bottom and paginates automatically — the "flow" counterpart to the Rectangle-based drawing API.
AddList appends a bulleted (ordered=false) or numbered list.
attributes.signature: *Flow AddList([]string items, bool ordered, TextStyle style)

attributes.docstring: AddParagraph appends a paragraph of flowing text (wraps and splits across pages).
AddTable appends a table (paginated when taller than a page).
Render lays out the queued elements into the document and returns the number of pages the flow occupies.

inherited.inherited_unit:129.list:
- **OCR** — recognition of text in scanned images; use a dedicated OCR library instead.
- **Conversion to non-PDF formats** other than HTML/XML — DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, EPUB, MOBI, Markdown,
  LaTeX, and similar are not supported; this edition is PDF in, PDF (or HTML/XML/raster) out.
- **Conversion from non-PDF formats** other than HTML — DOC, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, XPS, PCL,

  dynamic XFA layout/rendering layer itself is not reproduced.
- **3D annotations and PRC/U3D streams** are out of scope.
inherited.inherited_unit:131.list:
- **`PdfFileSecurity.setAllowExceptions`** throws `UnsupportedOperationException` — the legacy
  `AllowExceptions=false` toolkit-key-size path is not implemented.
- **Text replacement** with non-Latin scripts (CJK, Arabic, Hebrew) — basic cases work; complex
  bidi reordering and shaping edge cases may differ from a reference renderer.
- **Resource optimization** — basic stream recompression works; advanced strategies (image
  downsampling profiles, font merging across resources) are limited.
- **Tagged PDF / logical structure** — readable, and programmatic construction of structure trees
  is supported, but coverage for building fully well-formed structure trees is partial.
- **PDF/X validation and conversion** — `PdfFormat.PDF_X_1A`, `PDF_X_1A_2001`, and `PDF_X_3` are
  supported through the same `Document.validate`/`Document.convert` API used for PDF/A (ISO
  15930-1/-3 checks: info dictionary, output intents, the `/Trapped` key, embedded fonts), but
  this path has no dedicated test coverage yet.
- **Public-key-encrypted PDFs** are supported through the `ICustomSecurityHandler` interface, but
  no out-of-the-box helper for the common cases is provided yet.
